B1.note: Code merged; parameter names still need confirming against real captured Ads pings

B2.note: MAIN-world observer (extension/src/content/dataLayer.ts) wraps dataLayer.push via an accessor so GTM/gtag.js reassigning push stays inside the wrapper; handles late creation, renamed layers (gtm.js?l=), gtag arguments, and replays items already in the array. An isolated-world relay forwards to the worker, which drops anything not from a recorded tab's top frame, redacts with redact.ts and stores rows in a new IndexedDB 'datalayer' store (v4). GA4 events now carry Chrome's documentId, so sent/not sent is matched by event name within the exact page load (path fallback for worker hits). Log view has a 'Data layer' tab. Verified: typecheck, 198 unit tests (tests/datalayer.test.ts), build, e2e 18/18 incl. never_sent_test shown as 'not sent' in the viewer, unrecorded tab not hooked during a recording, followed-tab pushes recorded. Reviewer decisions: (1) injection is per tab via scripting.executeScript(world MAIN, injectImmediately) on webNavigation.onCommitted rather than the card note's registerContentScripts/document_start, because registered scripts can't be limited to a tab; pre-injection pushes are caught by replay. (2) Replayed pushes from a page loaded before Start get no verdict ('before recording'); Ads-only gtag events (send_to AW-) get none either. (3) Every non-gtm.* custom event key gets a verdict, so CMP events like OneTrustGroupsUpdated will read 'not sent'; a narrower rule could be a follow-up card. (4) The 'view_cart sent' e2e check needs network.
